definition: Initial injury report to employer/carrier, starting notice-deadline clock and claims workflow.
Wage-replacement benefits while a worker is completely unable to work, before MMI.
Compensation for lasting impairment that doesn't prevent all work — rated by body part/%. Critical for amputation and crush claims.
Benefits when an injury prevents any gainful employment — common in high-severity amputation or multiple body part cases.
Condition has stabilized and won't improve further. Triggers PPD rating and settlement discussions.
Evaluation by a neutral physician to verify diagnosis, MMI, or treatment appropriateness.
Pre-injury earnings base used to calculate indemnity benefits — sourced from payroll records.
Structured plan — light duty, modified duty, or full duty — to transition injured worker back to employment.
Median nerve compression at wrist. Most common repetitive motion injury in manufacturing assembly environments.
Occupational disease from prolonged vibrating tool use. Causes Raynaud's phenomenon (Vibration White Finger) in manufacturing workers.
Permanent hearing loss from manufacturing floor noise exposure — measurable by audiogram.
Federal Form 300 — mandatory recording of workplace injuries/illnesses for manufacturers with 10+ employees.
State-required form (C-1, FROI-1, etc.) to formally open a WC claim.
International Classification code standardizing diagnoses for WC billing and reporting.
Adjuster's estimate of total remaining cost to close — medical, indemnity, legal, expense.
Carrier's right to recover costs from a third party — equipment manufacturer, maintenance vendor, contractor.
Machine guards, gloves, hearing protection, eye protection, foot protection — critical in manufacturing WC prevention.
Nerve conduction test used to confirm and grade carpal tunnel syndrome severity.
Surgical fracture repair using rods, plates, or screws — common in forklift and machinery fracture cases.
Explosive electrical energy release — severe burn and blast hazard in manufacturing electrical work.
Claims handling targets: pick claim <1 day, approve <5 days, settle <30 days from FNOL.
Total cumulative payments (medical + indemnity + expense) from claim inception to current date.
AMA Guides-based rating expressing permanent impairment as % of the whole person.
Dividing disability liability between current occupational injury and pre-existing/non-occupational conditions.
Retraining or job placement when a worker can't return to their prior manufacturing role due to permanent restrictions.
